title: An owner asks Kevin, the AI console, for something FlowWeb cannot do yet, and it is saved as a build request the builder picks up
description: Step 1 of letting Daniel change FlowWeb by talking to Kevin. When an owner or admin asks for a function FlowWeb does not have, Kevin proposes a build request (title, what, done when); pressing Make this change saves it. Migration 0010 adds fw_build_requests: members read their business's requests, owners and admins add them through fw_build_request, and only the builder (service_role or the database owner) moves one along with fw_set_build_request (new, building, pr_open, done, declined) and records its pull request. api/v1.mjs serves GET and POST /v1/build-requests straight to the database, not through the relay. Settings lists the requests with their status and pull request. The builder that turns requests into pull requests is a later row; it never sends outreach, and database changes it needs still go to the Owner.
acceptance: An owner or admin saves a build request; a helper or viewer gets 403; a bad one gets 400
Every member lists their business's requests, never another business's
Only the builder moves a request along, and the list shows its status and pull request
Kevin proposes a build request to an owner, never to a helper or viewer
